eventDetail.scope: ICFTIC 2026 is an international conference focused on advancing research and innovation in information and computer technologies. It provides a global platform for scholars, researchers, and industry practitioners to exchange ideas, present research results, and promote collaboration. The conference will highlight developments in areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Big Data Analytics, Next-Generation Communication Networks, Internet of Things, Computer Vision, and Information Security. By bridging theory and practice, ICFTIC 2026 aims to promote innovation, support impactful applications, and address challenges in scalability, security, and system performance. Through interdisciplinary exchange and international participation, the conference seeks to foster collaboration and contribute to the future of information and computing technologies.
